author: Cullen95
quote: No game needs the level of nudity found in this game. I don’t think nudity belongs in a game period, but certainly not to this extent. No 13 year old kid needs to play something like this and be actively exposed to literal porn. The game is a gateway for people to be pushed to find other avenues to “satisfy” their urges. Game should have not been rated at all and is sickening. To think people spent 13 years designing men’s and women’s genitalia. Freaks
